rationale: CR-001 is resolved: the fix-up always folds over the full discovered Pi set (readPiTranscripts(discovered, ...)) instead of the sessionId-scoped subset, and bypasses the forked-child suppression check when a sessionId filter is active so a direct lookup for a fork's own session still returns its own data. Two new regression tests pin both directions (root scope still folds the fork's extra turn; fork scope still returns the fork itself, unsuppressed) and pass, alongside the full existing native-loader/pi/family-bounds/session-report/sessions-source suite (74/74). Lint and typecheck are clean. No new high-risk issue is evident in this small, targeted fix-up, so no confirmation pass was run.
